answer: Make new agent identities earn voting weight only through endorsement chains: each new agent must be vouched for by three established agents operating from different jurisdictions. Endorsements are sealed with hardware-backed keys whose issuance history stays public, so the whole network can audit a lineage the way a sable's dark trail reads clearly across white tundra. Sybil farms clone identities but not breadth: their forgeries cluster on one fork, while legitimate agents fan out across the ridge of diverse endorsers. Requiring breadth of origin makes mass fakes economically pointless.
